exclusions: Routine dental care and outpatient consultations

clauses.title: Room Rent & Accommodation Limits
clauses.text: Daily room rent is capped at 1% of Sum Insured (max INR 3,000/day). ICU charges capped at INR 7,500/day. Proportionate deductions apply to associated medical charges if room limit is exceeded.

clauses.title: Mandatory Co-Payment
clauses.text: A flat co-payment of 20% shall be borne by the insured person on all admissible claim expenses across all network and non-network hospitals.

clauses.title: Initial 30-Day Waiting Period
clauses.text: No indemnity claim for any illness or medical condition contracted within the first 30 days of the policy inception shall be admissible, except in cases of acute accidental injury.
